company_name: Shanghai Yikang Chemicals & Industries Co. Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides essential chemicals and materials used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Shanghai Yikang Chemicals & Industries Co., Ltd. is a key supplier of high-tech materials for the semiconductor industry, focusing on chemicals and materials such as photoresists, developers, adhesion promoters, primers, and anti-reflective coatings. Founded in 1993, the company enhances its offerings with professional support services, including technical assistance and logistics management, to optimize distribution efficiency.

regional_presence.China: Headquartered in Shanghai, serving as a central hub for manufacturing and distribution within China.
